Tagcast 0.41.0 makes album editing safer and browsing and playback less cluttered.
All changes are included in the standalone downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Album editing

- **Various Artists** is now an explicit checkbox in the album editor. It uses
  iBroadcast's native compilation album artist, while preserving each track's
  artists and credits. It also works for all discs of a displayed set and for
  selected albums by one album artist. Changes still require a draft review.
- Album and track years must be **1800–2050**, inclusive. **0 or an empty field**
  clears the year. Future releases are allowed, and both the editor and server
  reject out-of-range edits. The same check covers online suggestions and applying
  an album year to its tracks. An existing unusual year can remain unchanged while
  correcting other metadata.

## Browsing and player appearance

- **Album artists → Sort → Random** shuffles the full artist list before paging.
  Searching, filtering, paging and Back preserve that order. Choose a name sort
  and then Random again to reshuffle. Sorting uses the existing album summaries.
- Album cards show plain metadata such as **1985 · 11 tracks · album**, including
  browse groups and Album favourites. Named editions keep their edition label;
  missing-metadata warnings and multi-disc information remain visible.
- **Settings → Interface** has independent options to show **file format and
  stream quality** and **track artists** in the compact player. Both are on by
  default. Changes apply immediately and are remembered in this browser without
  restarting playback or changing the queue. Album/track pages and fullscreen
  Now playing retain their information. Hiding the quality label does not change
  the stream quality.

## Standalone downloads and updating

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `tagcast-0.41.0-macos-arm64.zip`.
- **macOS Intel:** `tagcast-0.41.0-macos-x64.zip`.
- **Windows x64:** `tagcast-0.41.0-windows-x64.zip`.
- **Linux x64:** `tagcast-0.41.0-linux-x64.tar.gz`.

Each download bundles Python, dependencies, the desktop launcher, a separate CLI
and license notices, with a companion SHA-256 checksum. Extract the whole package;
move `Tagcast.app` to Applications on macOS, open `Tagcast.exe` on Windows, or run
`./Tagcast` inside the extracted Linux folder. macOS and Windows downloads retain
the existing signing status and first-launch instructions in the README.

**Stop the old Tagcast before starting 0.41.0**, and let any cleanup finish or stop
it first. Otherwise the new launcher opens the already-running server. Settings,
tokens and the library cache stay in `~/.tagcast/`, or your configured `TAGCAST_HOME`.
Source installations remain supported with Python 3.11+ or uv.

For Homebrew, stop Tagcast, then run `brew update` and
`brew upgrade --cask cyberdeliaAI/apps/tagcast` after the tap's version and checksums
have been updated.

See the [README](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v0.41.0/README.md)
and [standalone guide](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v0.41.0/docs/native-builds.md)
for installation and feature details. Your local music files are never changed.
